changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_notification_settings (client_id, notification_type_id, channel, is_enabled) SELECT c.id, nt.id, settings.channel, settings.is_enabled FROM (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE client_number = 'C001') c CROSS JOIN notification_types nt CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('INVOICE_REMINDER', 'EMAIL', true), ('SERVICE_OUTAGE', 'SMS', true), ('PROMO', 'EMAIL', false), ('SECURITY_ALERT', 'EMAIL', true), ('CONTRACT_EXPIRING', 'EMAIL', true) ) AS settings(code, channel, is_enabled) WHERE nt.code = settings.code;

-- C001 is subscribed to the base "Podstawowy" package and the "Sport+" add-on for Komfort Plus 4K INSERT INTO client_package_subscriptions (client_number, tv_channel_package_id, service_id) SELECT 'C001', tcp.id, tcp.service_id FROM tv_channel_packages tcp JOIN service_translations st ON st.service_id = tcp.service_id AND st.language_code = 'pl' WHERE st.name = 'Komfort Plus 4K' AND tcp.name IN ('Podstawowy', 'Sport+');
-- And the base package for "Telewizja standard" INSERT INTO client_package_subscriptions (client_number, tv_channel_package_id, service_id) SELECT 'C001', tcp.id, tcp.service_id FROM tv_channel_packages tcp JOIN service_translations st ON st.service_id = tcp.service_id AND st.language_code = 'pl' WHERE st.name = 'Telewizja standard' AND tcp.name = 'Pakiet podstawowy';

changeSet.sql: UPDATE hardware h SET image_path = m.new_path FROM ( SELECT ht.hardware_id, m.new_path FROM hardware_translations ht JOIN (VALUES ('Router Wi-Fi 6', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/router-wifi-6.jpg'), ('Router Wi-Fi 7', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/router-wifi-7.jpg'), ('Modem światłowodowy', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/fiber-modem.jpg'), ('Dekoder 4K', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/decoder-4k.jpg'), ('Dekoder 4K Hybrid', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/decoder-4k-hybrid.jpg'), ('Telefon VoIP', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/voip-phone.jpg'), ('Karta SIM', 'http://localhost:8080/hardware/sim-card.jpg') ) AS m(name, new_path) ON m.name = ht.name WHERE ht.language_code = 'pl' ) AS m WHERE m.hardware_id = h.id AND h.image_path LIKE 'https://api.iconify.design/%';

-- C001 has read the first 3 global messages, the 4th is read+deleted, the rest stay unread INSERT INTO client_global_message_states (client_id, global_message_id, is_read, read_at, is_deleted) SELECT (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE client_number = 'C001'), gm.id, true, NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days', false FROM global_messages gm WHERE gm.title IN ('Pierwsza wiadomość', 'Druga wiadomość', 'Trzecia wiadomość');
INSERT INTO client_global_message_states (client_id, global_message_id, is_read, read_at, is_deleted) SELECT (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE client_number = 'C001'), gm.id, true, NOW() - INTERVAL '5 days', true FROM global_messages gm WHERE gm.title = 'Czwarta wiadomość';
